correctness.rationale: Equal outward types of siblings yield a two-way bisimulation by matching descendants whose chains of outward types from the sibling roots agree. The shared parent matches itself; equal child-type sets give forth and back. Conversely, following the unique parent distinguishes depths, and at each depth two bisimilar vertices have bisimilar parents. Inductively their parents agree, so distinct sibling types force the two vertices to agree. The root type of a rigid tree is its color and a q-element set of rigid child types; placing the types at fixed positions gives q! choices per internal vertex. This proves the two recurrences, the impossibility at positive height with a<q, and the fixed point at a=q. For the rate, the logarithmic correction Φ is bounded because R_h≥a≥q, so telescoping q^(−h) log R_h gives the absolutely convergent series. For a>q the ratio R_{h+1}/R_h is at least a/q>1; once log R_m>K/(q−1) for K a bound on |Φ|, the recurrence gives C≥q^(−m)(log R_m−K/(q−1))>0. The q^(h−1) disjoint bottom sibling families give probability at most p^{q^(h−1)}, p=(a)_q/a^q<1, so the limiting decay constant is positive. The frozen refinement script and output were inspected; a separate enumeration of binary two-color assignments refined by color and both child and parent class sets, reproducing 16/128 at height 2 and 256/32768 at height 3. These finite checks do not establish the rate.

evidence: For a rooted tree with m_j copies of each child-subtree shape T_j, Cheng gives D(T,k)=k ∏_j binom(D(T_j,k),m_j), with single-node value k, and characterizes the least k by child-class multiplicities.
The inspected modal papers address bounded contractions or path bisimulation, not this census.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Complete q-ary trees have one child shape of multiplicity q. Substituting k=a gives the exact R recurrence, not just a similar binomial recurrence. The action on distinguishing labelings is free and the rooted automorphism group independently permutes q children at every internal vertex, so the known orbit count gives the positioned count.

evidence: Cheng, Section 3, pp. 4–5: a rooted labeling is distinguishing iff the child labelings are distinguishing and no two child subtrees are isomorphic as labeled rooted trees; equivalence of labelings is defined by labeled isomorphism.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The bridge is by bottom-up induction: within already rigid or distinguishing child subtrees, outward types classify labeled rooted isomorphism, since every child type is used once and equal types give a unique matching of the child types. Thus the local tests coincide at every vertex. In an arbitrary nonrigid coloring, equal outward types need not imply isomorphism, but that cannot defeat the equivalence of the two global rigidity tests.

originality.rationale: The main census is covered by Cheng (2006), Theorem 3.2, under the equivalent formulation as distinguishing labelings of rooted trees. The equivalence applies to the whole rigidity condition, not to outward-type equality versus isomorphism on arbitrary colored subtrees. The positioned count, threshold and critical specialization follow directly from that theorem, and the rate follows by bounded-correction iteration of the known exact recurrence plus independent bottom sibling families. The exact rate was not located verbatim; that does not make the central enumeration distinct.
residual_risks: Exact-rate priority was not established. The demonstrated earlier coverage is of the census and its modal reformulation via distinguishing labelings; the rate is assessed as an elementary consequence, not claimed to appear verbatim in Cheng.

value.rationale: The modal interpretation is useful and the formulas are correct, but the positioned enumeration is a free-orbit conversion of a known exact rooted-tree formula. The remaining exponential statement uses elementary log iteration and the independent obstruction already present at the bottom stars. The record neither supplies a new count not mechanically implied by the known one nor identifies a scientific need met by that limited asymptotic corollary beyond the rephrasing.
